== Notes ==
* This skill creates a [[Spirit of Earthbind]].
* Useful to increase the knock downs caused by [[Wanderlust]], since they both benefit from the Communing attribute.
* This skill allows you to knock down [[Juggernaut|Juggernauts]], [[Siege Turtle|Siege Turtles]], [[Carrier Juggernaut|Carrier Juggernauts]], and [[Hauler Turtle|Hauler Turtles]].
